illustration.description: Flat cartoon illustration of a bald man walking in side profile, body hunched forward with his head tilted down and his chin pointing toward the ground. He wears a short-sleeved medium blue (#5B8FD6) t-shirt and dark navy blue (#2E4F80) jeans with dark charcoal shoes. One hand is tucked into his front pocket and the other arm hangs loosely. Bold black outlines, simple flat fills with subtle shading, clean vector-like children's-book style, plain white background, no text.
